method: Complete browser suite followed by targeted correction reruns, a new backup regression and a clean final run of all current-game checks. Unique cases are merged by file/title using the latest result; initial failures remain recorded below. No skipped tests or retries.
corrections: Persistence-fault injection now aborts campaign writes only; aborting every write also killed the unrelated writer-lease heartbeat before the tested transaction.
Four-view artwork interaction and six-layout/scale progression tests retain every assertion with explicit 60-second budgets.

Backup restoration left a stale visible drawer; loading now clears the drawer and transient placement/selection. Confirmed backup replacement and cancellation preserve ownership, wallet and claim fences across reload.
